name: citeverify
description: CiteVerify — Scientific Claim and Citation Verification System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run build -w apps/web" "npm run build -w apps/api"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently "npm run typecheck -w apps/web" "npm run typecheck -w apps/api" "npm run typecheck -w packages/shared"
scripts.test: concurrently "npm run test:run -w apps/web" "npm run test -w apps/api"
